subject: Order our chicken and eggs online 🐓 🥚
preview: Enjoy chicken and eggs from the farm all year round by ordering online for delivery or pickup.
body:
[PHOTO 1: the order page on a laptop, assets/images/online-ordering.png]

Ordering from the farm online has been open for a few weeks now. This summer was the first we sold our chicken, and we're grateful to everyone who tried it. Now you can keep buying from us after the market season ends. Here's a tour of how it works.

The order page at https://www.northfosterfarm.com/order/ has eggs by the dozen, whole chickens, cuts, and sausage. What's in stock changes as we go, and the page always shows what's available now. Choose what you'd like, say how you want to get it, and pay on the page. We email you to confirm your order.

There are three ways to get it:

DELIVERY
- We deliver every week on {deliveryDay}, between {deliveryFrom} and {deliveryTo}
- Order by {cutoff}
- As affordable as possible: {minimum} minimum, {fee} fee, free on orders of {feeWaivedAt} or more

ON-FARM PICKUP
- Pick a time when you order
- No fee, no minimum
- {farmAddress}

SCHEDULED PICKUP
- At the drop site: back on {dropDay} mornings in {dropTown}, {dropWindow}{dropStarting}
- {dropPlace}, in the same corner of the lot where our tent sits in market season
- Markets and pop-ups we open for pickup show up on the order page too, each with its own place and time
- Pick up your order for free

Do we deliver to you? Check your ZIP code on the map at https://www.northfosterfarm.com/#map. We deliver across much of Rhode Island, and just over the line in Connecticut, where we can deliver eggs only for now. Our delivery policy lists every town, along with our bulk discounts, from {bulkFirstOff} off orders of {bulkFirstAt} up to {bulkLastOff} off orders of {bulkLastAt}: https://www.northfosterfarm.com/delivery-policy/

You don't need an account to order. If you'd like one, there's no password: type the email you order with at https://www.northfosterfarm.com/login/ and we'll send you a link that signs you in. Signed-in customers can see past orders and receipts, change or cancel an order in progress, and keep a delivery address on file.

Our hens, although slowing down, will continue to lay for us all year round.

This is the first version of our online ordering system, and we want to hear how it works for you. Just reply to this email if you run into any problems.

One last thing: we're moving farm news to a new list, and it only goes to people who ask for it. This is the last update we'll send to this one. In the next few days you'll get one more email from us, with a Sign up button. Click it within {inviteLife} and you're on the new list; ignore it and you won't hear from us again. You can also sign up any time at https://www.northfosterfarm.com/news/, or tick the email box when you place an order.

— James and Jim

---

You're getting this because you joined the North Foster Farm email list. Reply with "unsubscribe" and we won't send you the sign-up email either. Follow along on Instagram at https://www.instagram.com/northfosterfarm
